title: Sweet Potato, Goat's Cheese and Pine Nut Quiche
subtitle: with chives
description: A buttery crust filled with golden sweet potato, goat's cheese, toasted pine nuts and chives in a creamy egg custard.

steps.text: Process the flour, 200 g cold cubed butter, 1 egg and salt in a food processor with a plastic blade to a crumbly mixture. Add 2 tbsp cold water and blend into a ball of dough. If still crumbly, add another spoonful of water.
Roll out the dough on a floured surface into a 30 cm round. Line the base and sides of the tin, prick the base with a fork and freeze for 1 hour.
Bake the case for about 20 minutes until lightly golden. Cool.

Melt the remaining 50 g butter in a pan, add the diced sweet potato and saute over medium heat for about 7 minutes until golden. Transfer to a bowl, add the diced goat's cheese, cream, pine nuts, chives and 3 beaten eggs, season with salt and pepper and mix. Pour into the base.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and set. Serve warm or at room temperature.
